slots.name: eclipse obscuration
slots.sentence: The country is also in line for a deep partial eclipse, with the sun expected to be obscured by between 90 percent in Lille, north of Paris, and 99.5 percent in Biarritz, in the southwest, according to Météo-France , the country’s weather service.
